core_obligations: Identify the closures: because the image is closed and the map is a homeomorphism onto it, the closure of the image of the subset is the image of the closure of the subset (proof lines 4286-4288)

Transfer emptiness of the interior: an open subset contained in that closure pulls back to an open subset contained in the closure of the original subset, hence is empty, and therefore so is the open subset (proof lines 4289-4292)
proof_roadmap: f(X) 闭且 f: X → f(X) 是同胚 ⇒ 闭包(f(T)) = f(闭包(T))。
若 V ⊂ Y 开且 V ⊂ 闭包(f(T))，则 U = f^{-1}(V) 开且 U ⊂ 闭包(T) ⇒ U = ∅ ⇒ V = ∅。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that a homeomorphism of a space onto a closed subset of another space carries nowhere dense subsets to nowhere dense subsets (author lemma at source lines 4278-4284, label lemma-closed-image-nowhere-dense). The proof (source lines 4286-4293) identifies the closure of the image with the image of the closure and transfers emptiness of the relevant interior through the homeomorphism (proof lines 4286-4292). The comparison of closures is the content. H2.
